name: Daro's Enclave
description: A rustic Sri Lankan heritage villa between Mirissa and Madiha offering authentic coastal experiences, whale watching, surfing, and traditional activities. Also serves as a dedicated research residency for field researchers studying marine biology, conservation, tropical ecology, archaeology, and cultural anthropology in the Indian Ocean region.
features: Surfing lessons in Weligama and Madiha
Local photo spots and cultural experiences
Research residency program for marine and conservation biology
High-speed fiber internet for data analysis and remote collaboration
Tropical garden workspace for on-site research activities
Quiet environment for month-long or multi-month field studies
research_opportunities: Blue whale research and marine mammal studies
Saltwater crocodile population surveys and human-wildlife conflict research
Sea turtle nesting ecology and conservation monitoring
Mangrove ecosystem restoration and biodiversity research
Rainforest bird research in Sinharaja UNESCO site
nearby_attractions: Galle Fort UNESCO World Heritage site
